⚠️ PLACEHOLDER KEYSTORE - REPLACE WITH YOUR OWN FOR PRODUCTION

This directory contains a placeholder keystore for testing purposes.

Current Configuration:
- Keystore: release.keystore (placeholder)
- Password: placeholder123
- Key Alias: release_key

To use your own keystore:
1. Replace release.keystore with your keystore file
2. Update signing.properties with your credentials
3. See README.md for detailed instructions

The current placeholder keystore works for testing but should NOT be used for production releases.
